title: Can “Sovereign Citizens” Win in Court? | Florida Traffic Stop - The Civil Rights Lawyer
summary: Civil-rights lawyer reviews a Florida sovereign arrest and Ford v. Antonides, showing federal courts dismiss right-to-travel claims as frivolous.

assertions.quote: These types of claims-that a plaintiff is entitled to different treatment as a “sovereign citizen”-are routinely rejected by federal courts as frivolous.
“sovereign citizen” argument that motor-vehicle registration and licensing laws do not apply to plaintiff rejected as frivolous
showing two people arrested after claiming essentially that laws don’t apply to them as sovereign citizens
